summaries.name: American Airlines
summaries.summary: American Airlines AAdvantage is its loyalty program; American is part of Oneworld and accepts transferred Chase Ultimate Rewards, but not Delta SkyMiles. The user's Feb 10 flight from New York to Los Angeles had a bad in-flight entertainment system (got a free-drink voucher); their LAX-JFK flight was delayed 2 hrs by weather. A Boston-Miami flight departs 7:00 AM via CLT for $173. In-flight entertainment: seat-back screens (Boeing 737-800, 777-200, Airbus A321T), tablets (737 MAX, A321), or personal-device streaming via the AA app. Service ratings: Skytrax 3/5, TripAdvisor 3.5/5, Consumer Reports 64/100 (phone 1-800-433-7300; also on Twitter/Facebook). Checked bags: $30/$40 first (free Premium Economy+), $40/$50 second; max 62in/50lbs, carry-on 22x14x9in. Delayed-bag Guarantee: delivered within 24 hrs or $25 voucher; lost bags reimbursed up to $3,500. Baggage Protection covers up to $1,000/bag (~$12-$20/trip); trip insurance via Allianz Global Assistance.

summaries.name: US Department of Transportation
summaries.summary: The US Department of Transportation publishes consumer protection rules that outline airline passengers' rights in the case of flight disruptions.
